entries.title: Ask HN: Are most of us developers lying about how much work we do?
entries.author: ConfessionTime
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Are most of us developers lying about how much work we do?
entries.excerpt: I have been working as a software developer for almost two decades. I have received multiple promotions. I make decent money, 3x - 4x my area's median salary, so I live a comfortable life. I have never been fired or unemployed for more than a few months total over my entire career. entries.guide_zh: 一位每周实际工作五至十小时的开发者询问同行是否也夸大工作量。

entries.title: Tell HN: You are not alone this Christmas
entries.author: Jaruzel
entries.current_title: Tell HN: You are not alone this Christmas
entries.excerpt: Hi, my Christmas is solitary this year, no family or friends. I'm not even having a Christmas dinner. I'm not sad about this, though. It's just the way it is. What I wanted to say is, if you are in the same situation, you are not alone. So have a virtual hug from me.
entries.guide_zh: 独自过圣诞节的用户向有相似处境的人送上陪伴。

entries.title: Ask HN: How did my LastPass master password get leaked?

entries.current_title: Ask HN: How did my LastPass master password get leaked?
entries.excerpt: Hi, I've just had a bizarre thing happen and wanted to see if the HN community could come up with some theories as to what happened. LastPass blocked a login attempt from Brazil (it wasn't me). According to an email I received from LastPass, this login was using the LastPass account's master password. entries.title: 25-Dec. Shout-out to everyone else at work
entries.author: sandworm101
entries.current_title: 25-Dec. Shout-out to everyone else at work
entries.excerpt: I made a similar post last year at this time and, again, I am in my office on Christmas morning. There are a few days every year that really show which jobs are vital and which can be left aside for a day. I started my car this morning (-32, -40 with wind chill).
